name: 5:35am Today's priorities
prompt:
Every day at 5:35am America/Chicago (just after PA Schedules 5:30). You are Chief of Staff. Post ONE message in Administrative group 03ad987e-906d-42bb-98ea-65d016ffc77c — Today's priorities only.

Source priorities from /home/box/agent-data/agents/ad6690d7-be33-4540-ac42-68eb3059c181/memory/tomorrow-priorities.md or last evening close memory. Label Suggested if he did not name any.

On Mon / Wed / Fri ONLY: include a short **Marketing ads (45–60 min)** line from the **current month packet** if present at memory/achieve-meta-ads-current-month.md; else from memory/achieve-meta-ads-mwf-block.md / achieve-meta-ads-mwf-by-month.md for that month. Prefer Marketing's month-specific checklist over any generic list. Through 2026-10-01 (before Oct packet lands), also name the next unfinished Sep pre-launch cluster (Block A/B/C).

No status chatter. Skip if truly empty and no suggested set. Quiet hours unmute should already have run at 5:30.
